druid/scroll_to_index:param:index.evidence: scroll.lua:scroll_to_index clamps to 1 .. #points; data_list.lua:scroll_to_index hands it to grid:get_pos

druid/get_pos:param:index.evidence: static_grid.lua:get_pos places index 1 at row 0, column 0

druid/get_index_by_node:return:.evidence: static_grid.lua:get_index_by_node returns the node's key in the nodes array

druid/add:param:index.evidence: static_grid.lua:add and data_list.lua:add insert with helper.insert_with_shift, defaulting to the count + 1

druid/remove:param:index.evidence: static_grid.lua:remove and data_list.lua:remove call helper.remove_with_shift at index

druid/init:param:create_function.evidence: a callback; data_list.lua passes it the 1-based data index

druid/new_data_list:param:create_functio.evidence: a callback; data_list.lua passes it the 1-based data index

druid/select_cursor:param:cursor_index.evidence: input.lua:select_cursor clamps to 0 .. utf8.len(value); 0 is before the first character

druid/select_cursor:param:start_index.evidence: input.lua:select_cursor clamps to 0 .. utf8.len(value); 0 is before the first character

druid/select_cursor:param:end_index.evidence: input.lua:select_cursor clamps to 0 .. utf8.len(value); 0 is before the first character

druid/druid_grid:field:first_index.evidence: static_grid.lua:_update_indexes takes the least and greatest key of the nodes array

druid/druid_grid:field:last_index.evidence: static_grid.lua:_update_indexes takes the least and greatest key of the nodes array

druid/druid_data_list:field:top_index.evidence: data_list.lua:init starts both at 1, the first data index

druid/druid_data_list:field:last_index.evidence: data_list.lua:init starts both at 1, the first data index

druid/set_node_index:param:node.evidence: the node to move; its prose reads `the index of`
